text:
Maria: Heads up finance — I paid for TSA PreCheck for new hire Jenna at the airport because the Redwood corp card declined at the kiosk. Charge $85.00 on my personal card, I forgot to save the receipt. Can I expense this against the relocation budget? cc @Alex for approval.

Expense-bot: Hi Maria — policy reminder: missing receipts over $75 require a Lost Receipt Form + a bank or card statement showing the charge. Submit via https://redwood.finance/expenses/lost-receipt and include manager approval in the Concur comment.

Maria: Uploading a screenshot of my bank statement to Concur now. TEMP LINK: https://imgur.com/xyz987 (will attach directly in Concur). Expense will be submitted under "Lost receipts".

Sam: Finance here — when you submit please: 1) Put "Relocation: Jenna start 2026-04-05" in the manager approval field, 2) redact card number and any passport/PII from uploads, 3) attach the bank statement transaction line showing the $85 exactly.

Alex: Confirming approval to charge relocation budget for Jenna's onboarding-related travel/background costs. Alex approved 2026-03-22.

Maria: Done — submitted Concur expense EXP-4921 with the screenshot and manager approval text. Did not include any PII. Anything else needed?

Expense-bot: EXP-4921 received. Status: awaiting finance review. Note: Because amount > $75 and receipt is missing, item is flagged but manager approval present. Expected reimbursement: 3 business days after review clearance.

Sam: All set from finance. Marking EXP-4921 Approved and routing for payment. Reminder for future: if corp card declines, please take a photo of the kiosk error and open a ticket to cards@redwood to get the merchant unblocked. Saves extra paperwork.

Maria: Thanks — will do. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

Alex: Thanks Maria. Welcome Jenna!

Expense-bot: Payment scheduled. Allow up to 72 hours for the refund to post. If payment fails, finance will reopen the thread.
